title: kriya receipt verification (OB-4, doc 33)
description: Re-verify kriya's signed OTel spans INSIDE your own Grafana. Each span carries kriya.receipt.raw (the exact signed line) + kriya.chain.head; the kriya Receipt Verifier panel re-checks every Ed25519 signature and its hash-chain position in the browser, with no call back to kriya. VERIFIED / BAD-SIG / NOT-A-KRIYA-SPAN — the same verdict `kriya-audit --verify-otel` and the Console produce.

options.content:
### kriya receipt verification
This dashboard re-verifies kriya-signed spans **in your browser**. Point the datasource at the kriya-exported spans (a table whose columns are the OTel attribute keys, incl. `kriya.receipt.raw` and `kriya.chain.head`). Nothing leaves your machine — kriya is not queried. See `tools/grafana-kriya-verify/README.md`.

panels.title: Signature re-verification
panels.description: One row per span: VERIFIED (signature + chain.head self-consistent), BAD-SIG (a kriya span that failed a check), NOT-A-KRIYA-SPAN (no kriya.receipt.raw).
